content.short: Perpmate is a privacy-focused perpetuals interface running on Hyperliquid.
content.description: Perpmate trades perpetuals through Hyperliquid while keeping the trader's positions from being publicly attributable. Hyperliquid's transparency is a genuine feature for verification and a genuine problem for anyone whose size makes them a target, and this sits squarely in that gap.
content.meta: Trade Hyperliquid perpetuals without positions being publicly attributable to you.
